injuries.name: Justin Danforth
injuries.note: Danforth's move to IR allowed the Sabres to activate Sam Carrick (middle body) ahead of Thursday's game versus the Ducks. Danforth remains without a clear timeline to return to action. He will miss his fourth straight game Thursday and will be eligible to return whenever ready, as long as he doesn't later end up on long-term injured reserve.

injuries.name: Matt Grzelcyk
injuries.note: Buffalo placed Grzelcyk on injured reserve Tuesday. He hasn't played since Opening Night against Columbus on Oct. 1. With Rasmus Dahlin (upper body) and Grzelcyk unavailable, the Sabres recalled Dennis Gilbert from AHL Rochester to play against Montreal on Tuesday.

injuries.name: Brad Marchand
injuries.note: Marchand is slightly behind Aleksander Barkov (knee) in terms of his potential return date. Barkov should be back in the fold within the next three games, per head coach Paul Maurice on Saturday. The 38-year-old Marchand has appeared in only two games this season and hasn't been in the lineup since Oct. 6 against the Kings.

injuries.name: Aleksander Barkov
injuries.note: Barkov has appeared in only two games this season and hasn't played since Oct. 1. However, he is close to returning to the lineup. Once activated by the Panthers from long-term injured reserve, Barkov should occupy a top-six role while seeing time on the power play and penalty kill.

injuries.name: Jonah Gadjovich
injuries.note: It's a step in the right direction for Gadjovich, who hasn't played since Oct. 25, 2025, against the Golden Knights, missing over a year of action. Given his extended layoff, the winger's return to practice doesn't mean he will be returning soon. Still, Gadjovich should slot into a bottom-six role for the club once given the all-clear.
